items: Important: Map does not extend Collection. Hence, no direct iterator available.
Array: A fixed-size container that can hold multiple items of the same type.
Collection: A group of objects.
Set: A collection with no duplicate elements.
List: An ordered collection that allows duplicates.
Map: A collection of key-value pairs.
Iterator: An object for traversing elements one by one.
ListIterator: An iterator for Lists that supports bidirectional movement.
HashSet: Unordered Set that eliminates duplicates.
LinkedHashSet: Maintains insertion order and eliminates duplicates.
TreeSet: Stores sorted, unique elements.
HashMap: Key-value mapping with no order guarantee.
LinkedHashMap: Maintains insertion order in a Map.
TreeMap: Sorted Map based on keys.
